name: Four-Tier Hierarchical Ray Packet Marching
definition: A spatial skipping technique that operates on Ray Packets (RPs) encompassing multiple rays to increase parallelism, unlike single-ray methods like HESS.
summary: Four-Tier Hierarchical Ray Packet Marching is a spatial skipping technique for neural volume rendering that uses ray packets, a four-tier hierarchy, and a lag-first scheduler to handle divergence and reduce computational load.
